description: Check whether an uploaded or imported video is ready. Pass the version id an upload returned (its asset_id) or an asset id (resolves to its current version); a folder id is refused. status is one of: ready; pending_ingest, processing, preparing or waiting (still working - check again in a few seconds; transfer_progress shows an import's download progress, progress the video processing percent); error (terminal - read error_message, stop polling and upload the file again); no_versions (the asset has no media yet). Returns asset_id (the asset), version_id (the version checked), url (current version) and version_url (this version).

asset_id.description: Version id (from an upload) or asset id to check

name: asset_status
title: Check processing status
